recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It completes the Published FHIR-34100 resolution in active Encounter source without implementing non-final FHIR-54316 comment wording; revisit FHIR-54316 separately if PA finalizes that clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-34100 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. The request asked to remove Group as an Encounter participant, but the final PA decision kept Patient and Group as possible participant actors while adding guardrails: Patient/Group participants must not carry participant.type and any Patient/Group participant actor must also be the Encounter.subject.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by commit 49ef4a005163617c3019647acedd1eaab45b175d, merged by PR #2391, which added Encounter.participant guidance and invariant enc-2 preventing participant.type for Patient/Group actors. That commit did not add the second requested enforceable constraint requiring the Patient/Group actor to match Encounter.subject; current source only carried that rule as prose in Encounter.participant.comment.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists encounter=Encounter, so source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml and the Encounter invariant-tests directory are current build inputs. FHIR-54316 is related later context, but it is still Waiting for Input and concerns explanatory comments for existing invariants, so it was not decided in this run. PA 2026 WGM minutes also record that the last FHIR-34100 constraint was not applied, confirming the omission rather than reversing the original decision.
reconciliation: Added Encounter invariant enc-3 requiring a Patient or Group participant actor to have the same reference as Encounter.subject, marked Encounter.participant.actor with the new condition, and added a failing invariant test where a contained Patient participant is not the Encounter.subject.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: added Encounter.participant invariant enc-3 and marked Encounter.participant.actor with condition enc-3.
source/encounter/invariant-tests/enc-3.f1.fail.xml: added a failing invariant example for a Patient participant actor that is not the Encounter.subject.

related_jiras.note: Later Waiting for Input issue about enc-1/enc-2 explanatory comments; it confirms FHIR-34100 as the source of the invariants but is not final enough to decide here.
